meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the CZ CELLxgene Census, a public single-cell database. It filters by organism, tissue, etc., and retrieves cell metadata, gene expression, summary counts, or passes data to scanpy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to query public single-cell data by organism, tissue, disease, etc., or when you need gene expression, cell metadata, summary counts, or other Census data.
